title: Retire implementers after the final review; should-fix as a warm turn
description:
In skills/ticks/references/agent-runner.md: loop step 4g and step 5, "Amortize: pool worktrees", "Reviewing the work" (the "If a reviewer finds issues" sentence and the should-fix policy), and "Closing the epic".

The text must say:
- Implementers, and the worktree or branch a warm turn needs, are retired after the epic's final review, not after their tick. Closing the tick still happens at the wave gate.
- The final review's should-fix (and blocker) items route back to the chain or implementer that wrote the code, as a warm turn, on its branch advanced to the integration commit.
- If the warm worker is gone, the fallback is a fresh dispatch, noted in the dispatch ledger.
- The mechanism is the adapter's (claude-runner and codex-runner own it; another chain edits those files). Do not restate it here.

Shared vocabulary (verbatim across all three parallel chains, which do not see each other):
- Files: `.tick/learnings.md` is the always-read head (at most 4096 bytes: hard rules plus an index of the body's categories). `.tick/learnings-ref.md` is the looked-up body (Problem/Cause/Rule entries, at most 16384 bytes, at most 800 bytes per entry). The 800-byte entry limit applies to the body only. The engine owns the format; the project owns the content.
- Check labels in implementer reports: the tick-gate command verbatim, `by-path run`, `planted fault`.
- Check outcomes: `ran clean`, `went red and changed the code`, `went red, not from this change`, `not applicable`.
- Terms: "parallel warm-chains", "warm turn", "retire" (an implementer is retired after the final review).
- Existing section titles in agent-runner.md stay as they are. The gate names are "tick gate" and "wave gate", already defined.
Spec (source of truth): docs/thoughts/2026-11-12-lean-epics.md. Edit only skills/ticks/ (never an installed copy) unless your task names other files. Keep the engine's terse voice; criteria, not step lists.
acceptance_criteria:
- `grep -ni 'warm turn' skills/ticks/references/agent-runner.md` hits in "Reviewing the work" and in the loop
- No text retires an implementer, or removes the worktree it needs, at tick close before the final review
- The fallback (fresh dispatch, noted) is stated
